title: NSW Labor is ‘trampling over party principles’ with preselections by captain’s call, members say
summary_full: Exclusive: Ryde councillor Penny Pedersen was asked by Labor head office not to nominate for Lane Cove in March state electionGet our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastLabor’s New South Wales leadership has been accused of alienating members and undermining the democratic process, after multiple state election candidates were preselected by “captain’s call” instead of the rank and file.The premier, Chris Minns, announced on Friday that commercial litigator Jade Tyrrell will be Labor’s candidate for the marginal Liberal-held seat of Lane Cove at March’s state election.
